svg.text: Trillium T1: perfboard layout and wiring
2.54 mm perfboard, 11 x 18 holes (27.94 x 45.72 mm), scale 3:1. Holes named column letter + row number (A1 = top-left, component side, USB-C at top).
Shaded corners: keep free (enclosure supports and clamps).
Grey: F1-only parts (not fitted on T1).
Use 28-30 AWG insulated solid wire. Trim leads to <= 1 mm under the board
(T1: the cell sits below). Straight lines = point-to-point insulated wires.
Off-board: BT1 cell plugs into J1 (red = J1.1 '+').
U1.BAT- is common with GND inside U1: no wire.
SW2/SW3 extra pins: solder for strength only.
